content.short: Juicebox provides DAO infrastructure on Ethereum.
content.description: Juicebox is a versatile DAO-tooling platform that accelerates the setup and ongoing governance of decentralized communities. It serves DAOs looking to crowdfund and NFT projects seeking a smooth, integrated path to build and manage their communities. Since its inception, notable DAOs such as Constitution DAO and Assange DAO have emerged from Juicebox, demonstrating its impact on funding campaigns and community-building initiatives within the Web3 ecosystem.
content.meta: Juicebox is a multipurpose DAO-tooling platform for building and managing DAOs. Discover Juicebox and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
